guidance: Sequence delivery as outcome-named milestones with owners, verification, and status. Choose product-level mode from a PRD, or implementation-level mode from a Design Spec, Change Request, or Work Scope Brief. Do not invent owners, dates, progress, or missing architecture. A new plan sets every milestone status to Planned.

outline.title: Plan Context
outline.guidance: Anchor the plan to its source spec and the delivery outcome. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Source Spec
children.guidance: Name the exact source this plan delivers (PRD, Design Spec, Change Request, or Work Scope Brief) by document id when locked and by title for display. Do not restate its content.

children.title: Plan Mode
children.guidance: Write exactly `product-level` when the source is a PRD: outcome slices, owners, dependencies, and decision points. Write exactly `implementation-level` when the source is a Design Spec, Change Request, or Work Scope Brief: contracts, migrations, and technical ordering may drive milestones.

children.title: Delivery Outcome
children.guidance: State the observable result when every milestone in this plan is Done. Keep it to one outcome, not a backlog.

outline.title: Milestones
outline.guidance: Group the sequenced slices of work. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Milestone
children.guidance: Title each instance with the milestone outcome, not "Milestone 1".

children.title: Goal and Scope
children.guidance: State what this milestone delivers and what it explicitly leaves for later. Keep the slice shippable on its own.

children.title: Work Items
children.guidance: List the concrete tasks this milestone requires. Name artifacts, not vague chores.

children.title: Owner
children.guidance: Name the person or team accountable for this milestone. Use Unassigned when the owner is unknown; never invent a name.

children.title: Dependencies
children.guidance: List earlier milestones or external blockers this milestone needs. Omit if it can start immediately.

children.title: Verification and Done
children.guidance: List the checks that prove this milestone is complete. Prefer observable outcomes over process checkboxes.

children.title: Status
children.guidance: One of Planned, In Progress, Blocked, or Done. A new plan sets every milestone to Planned.

children.title: Implementation Record
children.guidance: Append after this milestone completes. Title each instance with the date, and write the record in the instance body. Do not pre-fill.

outline.title: Cross-Cutting Context
outline.guidance: Capture sequencing across milestones and shared risks. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Sequencing
children.guidance: State the order milestones must run and which ones may proceed in parallel. In a product-level plan, label unresolved technical sequencing `Needs design decision` or `Validation required before implementation`; do not invent architecture to fill the gap.

children.title: Shared Risks
children.guidance: List risks that span more than one milestone. Omit if none are known.
